summary.text: Alliances is set on Dominaria as the Ice Age ends, when Freyalise casts her World Spell and the new climate brings floods and plagues that ravage the continent and reduce Terisiare to an archipelago.

The story follows the mage Jodah and Jaya Ballard, who rescues him from the necromancer Lim-Dûl after he is drugged and imprisoned in Tresserhorn, while the races form an alliance to defeat Lim-Dûl and his undead army, bent on world domination.
Later, when Jaya puts on Mairsil's ruby ring, she is possessed and stabs Jodah, but Jodah smashes his mirror in her face, burning away Mairsil and Lim-Dûl and triggering Jaya's planeswalker spark.
